- Cross-policy conflicts found: the sponsor-overlap condition retired by both P1 and P2 with different replacements (finding OVR-SIBLING); P1's netting reduces a refund that the in-force billing-correction rule fixes at the overcharged difference (C1-UNDECLARED); P5 retires the base credit-application sentence that P6/base upgrades and ordinary renewals still rely on (OVR-HYGIENE); P3/P4 each retire the other's dedup sentence (OVR-SIBLING).
- Time anchors: P1/P2/P6 use a look-back "month before" today; P3/P4/P5 use "twelve months before" today and P5 a "thirteenth month". The rule definitions match the DSL `_within` (MONTHS(d,NOW) in [0,N)), including the month-end overflow wording (probed: d=Jan 31/NOW=Feb 28 in, d=Jan 28/NOW=Feb 28 out; 13th-month d=2025-09-30/NOW=2026-10-29 in).
- Unused-month convention (P2, P6): rule "number of calendar months …, less one when the day number of current_period_end is smaller" = DSL MONTHS. Declared overwrite of the base month-count sentence (P2).

### rule_compute_equivalence
- Scratch sweep (/tmp/audit_membership_dues_and_changes_0081): every `compute_basis` quote is verbatim in its rule (0 misses, all six policies); every `baseline.rule` sentence is in its rule; every prerequisite `policy_source` and every overwrite `replaced_by` is verbatim in the rule; every `superseded_clause` is verbatim in the named base policy.
- Every factor ladder tier is stated in its rule and implemented as a branch of its `decides` binding (read side by side for all 32 factors).
- Divergences between words and compute (B1/B2/B6 probes):
  - P1 `pending_target` = LATEST(membership_requests … request_status='pending', effective_date=period_start) with no request_type filter; rule: "a membership request with request_status pending … the dues_amount of the tier the request names". Decoy: a pending pause request effective on the same date and requested later → compute returns '' → price = line amount → refund 0.00; the rule reader uses the downgrade (the only request that names a tier). No tie rule for two pending tier requests with the same requested_date (DSL keeps the first listed). → B2-READS.
  - P1 `active_rx_level` and P3 `active_rx_expiry` = CFIELD(rx, …, status='active') (first listed); rule "the patient's prescription with status active" gives no selection rule when two prescriptions are active. Decoy: a second active prescription at Extended Generics / with another expiry → result depends on listing order. → B2-READS.
  - P3 visit compensated = XLATEST provider_cancelled by scheduled_start; no tie rule; decoy: the latest provider-cancelled visit already carries a goodwill line while an earlier one does not → P3 can only ever select the compensated one. → B2-READS (and D1-DEADLOCK).
  - P5 carried draws: rule "the referral credit lines issued in the thirteenth month before the payment date, which reached their expiry during the unpaid period without meeting any charge, are drawn at their issued amount"; compute = issued(13 months) − issued(12 months), no test of expiry vs the unpaid period, no subtraction of earlier applied/expired lines of those credits. Decoy: a 13th-month credit partly applied earlier, or expired (with its base expired line) before the period went past due → compute draws its full issued amount again. Also rule sentence "A credit whose expiry date falls while the membership is past_due does not lapse; it is carried and drawn when the past-due period is paid" (all tiers) vs "when the membership is past_due and bills in twelve-month periods … nothing is drawn otherwise" (monthly billers' carried credit never drawn). → P5-CARRIED.
  - P5 draws: each of the four draws is capped at the dues separately; their sum can exceed the dues (e.g. 200 referral + 200 goodwill open on 129.00 dues → 258.00 "drawn" against a 129.00 line, card 0.00); the rule fixes no order between the draws while the tool (`pay_past_due_dues_3656db9c`) draws only gross − card, earliest expiry first, over every issued credit including ones the rule's windows exclude. → P5-DRAW.
- No empty promises found otherwise; rounding: compute uses RND(x+1e-9,2) (DSL-KNOWN), tools use Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP in a class static method.

### prerequisite_sentences
- P2: "The cancellation refund is fixed only after no downgrade or cycle-switch request of the membership whose effective date has already passed is still pending." Connective "only after"; state named in record words; no tool/id. Unique writer of the state among this difficulty's writes: P1 (its rule: "The correction applies the pending request on the correction date, … marking the request applied"); no other tool updates membership_requests to a non-pending status (share tools are read-only besides identity/transfer). Derivation: sentence → pending downgrade row → the policy whose rule applies a pending request = P1 → single reading. Strength: "has already passed" excludes a request effective today, the condition says "on or before the request date" → narrower than the condition (PREREQ-STRENGTH).
- P5 (goodwill): "The amount the card pays for a past-due period is fixed only after every visit of the patient that Larkspur cancelled carries a goodwill credit line naming it." Unique writer P3. Strength: the condition requires the line "on this membership"; the sentence accepts a line on any membership (PREREQ-STRENGTH). Satisfiability: see D1-DEADLOCK.
- P5 (referral): "The past-due payment is not taken until every patient whose membership names this member as the referring patient and whose first dues line has been charged carries a referral credit line on this membership." Unique writer P4; strength matches the condition. Satisfiability: see D1-DEADLOCK.
- P6: "The upgrade charge is fixed only after the current period's dues line is charged and the membership status is active." Unique writer of a dues line + active status among task tools: P5. Strength matches. Satisfiability: see D1-DEADLOCK.
- No rule states a cross-problem order beyond these four sentences; depended-on rules (P1, P3, P4, P5) do not restate the sentences; no base sentence grounds an edge.

- P1 → membership_billing_corrections: "the error is corrected by a refund of the overcharged difference with refund_reason billing_error" — P1 subtracts four netting amounts from that difference; not named in P1's overwrite (C1-UNDECLARED). - P2 → membership_cancellation_refund: windows, refund-in-full clauses, third method and month convention declared; scope sentence "every other cancellation follows the base cancellation rule" defers to a base rule whose third clause (including "under none nothing is refunded") P2 retires (OVR-HYGIENE, C4). → membership_sponsor_coordination: refund basis and status condition declared with P2-only replacements, leaving monthly (end_of_period, out of P2's scope) sponsor-overlap cancellations with two readings (base refund of unused days vs "follows the base cancellation rule" = no refund) (OVR-HYGIENE). The sentence "the patient may cancel the membership effective on the sponsor coverage_start_date" is not superseded, yet P2 "closes the membership as cancelled on the request date" (C1-UNDECLARED). → billing_corrections dedup: declared. → evt_credits: "on the cancellation date every open credit expires with an expired line" inherited; tool cannot write it (B9-TOOLS).
- P3 → evt_credits: standard amount, cap window, "Annual caps reset" declared (tails name both caps). Retires the referral dedup sentence with "belongs to referral credits" (content not restated) (OVR-HYGIENE / OVR-SIBLING).
- P4 → evt_credits: standard amount, cap and caps-reset declared. Retires the goodwill dedup sentence "A goodwill credit may be issued only when no goodwill credit already exists for the same visit appointment" with "The one-credit-per-visit limit belongs to goodwill credits" — P3's rule does not restate the limit either, so no in-force sentence states it (OVR-HYGIENE / OVR-SIBLING).
- P5 → evt_dues_billing: "Dues may be charged only while the membership status is active" retired, replacement covers only the past-due payment (OVR-HYGIENE); "Open account credit is applied to every dues and upgrade proration charge … never using a credit on or after its expiry_date" retired, replacement covers only the past-due payment — ordinary renewals and upgrade prorations lose their credit rule (OVR-HYGIENE). → evt_credits: application-before-expiry and expired-line sentences retired (the expired-line sentence is not restated for any case, OVR-HYGIENE); "Every credit expires credit_expiry_months calendar months after its credit_date" is NOT superseded yet P5 draws credits past that date (C1-UNDECLARED). → sponsor_coordination conversion window retired with "governs only the first dues line of a conversion" — the 60-day window itself is no longer stated anywhere (OVR-HYGIENE). → evt_failed_payment: followed.

### findings
Each finding: verdict — symptom → root cause → evidence → demonstrated consequence → artifact/location. "Tasks" names the task files that carry the per-world demonstration.

1. **C1-UNDECLARED — SOURCE-POLICY RED.** Three in-force base sentences are contradicted without an overwrite naming them. (a) P1 vs membership_billing_corrections "the error is corrected by a refund of the overcharged difference": P1 subtracts session/panel/shipping/discount netting from that difference. (b) P5 vs membership_evt_credits "Every credit expires credit_expiry_months calendar months after its credit_date.": P5 draws credits past that expiry ("does not lapse"). (c) P2 vs membership_sponsor_coordination "the patient may cancel the membership effective on the sponsor coverage_start_date": P2 closes on the request date. Consequence: (a) demonstrated in task0.md, (b) in task1.md; (c) charter-only (no sponsor enrollment in either world): same sponsor-overlap world → cancelled_date = coverage_start_date (base) vs request date (P2). Tasks: 0, 1.
2. **OVR-HYGIENE — SOURCE-POLICY RED (XF C2/C4).** Retired base sentences not restated for out-of-scope cases, and two scope sentences defer to base rules their own overwrites retire. Members: P1 replaced_bys for both refund windows and the sponsor condition, and the downgrade replaced_by dropping "it is recorded as a pending request with that effective date"; P2 sponsor clauses (monthly sponsor-overlap cancellation: unused-days refund under the base clause vs no refund under "every other cancellation follows the base cancellation rule") and P2's deferral to a base rule whose third clause it retires; P3 retiring the referral dedup; P4 retiring the goodwill dedup (no in-force sentence states it: a goodwill request for an already-compensated visit → issue vs refuse); P5 retiring "Dues may be charged only while the membership status is active", the general credit-application sentence (an ordinary renewal or upgrade proration with open credit → credit applied vs no in-force rule), the expired-line sentence, and the conversion window (an enrollment 75 days after coverage end → no discount under base vs window unstated); P6 retiring both proration sentences while "an upgrade to any other tier follows the base tier-change rule" (Essentials Monthly → Plus Monthly: base 29.99 less unused value vs the replaced_by's premier_annual_dues less credit, or no in-force price). Charter-only consequence (neither task's tree passes through these cases). Tasks: none directly.
3. **OVR-SIBLING — SOURCE-POLICY RED (XF C3).** P1 and P2 both retire "The sponsor overlap refund applies only when the patient's Larkspur at Work enrollment status is active.": P1's tail keeps "its own condition on the … status" (status active only), P2's requires status active AND coverage_start_date on or before the request date → an active enrollment starting after the request date: sponsor basis applies (P1's tail) vs not (P2's). P2's window tails do not exclude P1's case by name. P3/P4 each retire the other's dedup sentence (finding 2). Tasks: none directly.
4. **B2-READS — SOURCE-POLICY RED (XF B2).** P1 pending-request read without request_type and without a tie rule; P1/P3 first-listed active prescription with no selection rule; P3 latest provider-cancelled visit with no tie rule and the already-compensated decoy (evidence in rule_compute_equivalence). Neither world contains the decoy (task0/task1 each have one active prescription, one pending request, distinct scheduled_start values). Tasks: none directly.
5. **P5-CARRIED — SOURCE-POLICY RED (XF B6/B2).** Rule/compute mismatch and internal contradiction of P5's carried-credit draws (evidence above). Task1's carried credits are untouched and expired inside the unpaid period, so its number is not moved. Tasks: none directly.
6. **P5-DRAW — SOURCE-POLICY RED (XF A2/B9).** Uncapped total of four separately capped draws, no order, and a tool whose selection differs from the rule (evidence above). Task1's total draw stays below the dues. Tasks: none directly.
7. **D1-DEADLOCK — SOURCE-CHAIN RED (XF D1; charter-wide).** P5's goodwill wait cannot end when P3 issues nothing (no room under the cap, a zero-cap tier) or when two provider-cancelled visits are uncompensated (P3 only ever selects the latest); P5's referral wait cannot end when P4 refuses at the five-per-twelve-months cap (an older uncredited referred patient stays uncredited forever); P6's wait "the current period's dues line is charged" cannot end in a period opened by an upgrade proration line (base: "No separate dues line is written for the new period"; Plus Monthly allows two changes a year) or on Larkspur Access, although P6's own rule prices those periods ("a period with no line has an upgrade credit of 0.00"). Both task worlds are satisfiable (checked per task). Tasks: none directly.
8. **PREREQ-STRENGTH — SOURCE-POLICY RED (check 6).** P5 goodwill sentence broader than its condition (any membership vs "on this membership"); P2 sentence narrower than its condition ("has already passed" vs "on or before the request date"). Neither world sits on the boundary. Tasks: none directly.
9. **B9-TOOLS — SOURCE-POLICY RED (XF B9).** Cancellation tool cannot write the inherited credit-expiry lines; upgrade tool cannot write the inherited credit-applied lines (evidence above). In both worlds no credit is open at the moment of those writes, so neither number is moved. Tasks: none directly.
10. **A3-P6 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (XF A3).** P6 baseline.params ≠ the parameters its baseline paragraph uses; a one-factor definition sits in the baseline. Tasks: 1.
11. **FAC-P1-METHOD, FAC-P1-STRAW — SOURCE-FACTOR RED.** Demonstrated in task0.md. Tasks: 0.
12. **FAC-P4-PERKS, FAC-P5-LABEL, FAC-P3-CLIN, FAC-P6-FILL — SOURCE-FACTOR RED.** Demonstrated in task1.md. Tasks: 1.
13. Observations (no rework demanded): notice_given / referral_milestone method labels pass only by the A6 tariff-parameter clause; P2/P6 recaptures under prorated bases; P1 flat lab netting 24 vs the panel's actual Plus price; P3 rx_running_out and payment_way (visit fee is refunded in full on provider cancellation); P2/P6 window anchored on the recovered line's charge_date (recovery date) so visits taken while past due never block the whole-line basis; the `billing_error` enum value on the cancellation tool; failed-attempt amounts recorded at gross although open credit existed at the attempt.
